AdminSafehouse.label: Admin safehouses
AdminSafehouse.description: Allows administrators and moderators to claim safehouses.

SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim.label: Required survival days
SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim.description: Number of in-game days a player must survive before claiming a safehouse.

SafeHouseRemovalTime.label: Inactive removal period
SafeHouseRemovalTime.description: Removes a safehouse when none of its members have visited it for the specified number of real-world hours.

DisableSafehouseWhenPlayerConnected.label: Protect only while offline
DisableSafehouseWhenPlayerConnected.description: Disables safehouse protection while any member is connected.

SafehouseAllowTrepass.label: Allow trespassing
SafehouseAllowTrepass.description: Allows non-members to enter safehouses without an invitation.

SafehouseAllowLoot.label: Allow looting
SafehouseAllowLoot.description: Allows non-members to loot containers and move objects in safehouses.

SafehouseAllowRespawn.label: Allow respawning
SafehouseAllowRespawn.description: Allows members to choose their safehouse as a respawn location.

SafehouseAllowNonResidential.label: Non-residential safehouses
SafehouseAllowNonResidential.description: Allows non-residential buildings to be claimed as safehouses.

FactionDaySurvivedToCreate.label: Required survival days
FactionDaySurvivedToCreate.description: Number of in-game days a player must survive before creating a faction.

FactionPlayersRequiredForTag.label: Members required for a tag
FactionPlayersRequiredForTag.description: Number of faction members, including the owner, required to create a faction tag.

PublicName.label: Server name
PublicName.description: Name shown in the in-game and Steam server browsers.

PublicDescription.label: Server description
PublicDescription.description: Description shown in the in-game and Steam server browsers.

Public.label: Public listing
Public.description: Lists the server in the in-game public server browser. Steam-enabled servers remain visible in the Steam server browser.

Open.label: Open server
Open.description: Allows players without an existing whitelist account to join. When disabled, accounts must be created by an administrator.

MaxPlayers.label: Maximum players
MaxPlayers.description: Maximum number of regular players connected at once. Values above 32 may cause poor map streaming and desynchronization.

AutoCreateUserInWhiteList.label: Create accounts on join
AutoCreateUserInWhiteList.description: Adds unknown usernames to the whitelist when they join an open server. Players provide their own username and password.

MaxAccountsPerUser.label: Accounts per Steam user
MaxAccountsPerUser.description: Maximum number of accounts one Steam user can create. Does not apply when using the Host menu.

DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath.label: Remove account after death
DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath.description: Removes a regular player's whitelist account after death, preventing them from creating another character on a closed server.

AllowNonAsciiUsername.label: Non-ASCII usernames
AllowNonAsciiUsername.description: Allows usernames containing non-ASCII characters, such as Cyrillic letters.

AllowCoop.label: Split-screen players
AllowCoop.description: Allows additional local players to join through split-screen co-op.
